description: For any set A of nonempty sets, there is a function graph on A selecting a member of each set; its values lie in the union of A.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.AxiomaticSetTheory.family_choice_graph.{u} (A : ZFSet.{u}) (hA : ∀ x ∈ A, x.Nonempty) :
  ∃ G, A.IsFunc A.sUnion G ∧ ∀ x ∈ A, ∃ y ∈ x, x.pair y ∈ G
